I'll start by inspecting the workspace and the docs.

Now I'll refresh the lock through the mirror as the contract says, then pin fieldsplit below 0.4.3 because 0.4.3 needs Rust 1.70.

Next the Makefile, which needs the path remap.

Tests pass. Now the contract checks: reproducibility in two directories, an incremental edit of the site table, the version stamp, and the `COMMIT` handling.

The version change fails under `--frozen` only because `Cargo.lock` records the workspace version, so it has to be regenerated first. I'll check that case with the lock refreshed offline.

`/app/target/release/binloc` was left over from the no-default-features build. I'll rebuild it properly and rerun the behaviour probes.

Those results match the docs. I'll check how fieldsplit trims blanks, since the docs say only spaces and tabs are ignored.

Fieldsplit trims only spaces and tabs, as the docs require. Last, I'll check for compiler warnings, remove build artifacts and write the status file.

The workspace now builds with rustc 1.63 and meets the build contract. I checked each requirement with a command, and `/app/STATUS.json` says `success`.

**What I fixed**
- **Compiler version:** `rust-version` in `[workspace.package]` was 1.65 and is now 1.63. `lib.rs` used `let … else`, which 1.63 doesn't have, so I rewrote it as a `match`.
- **Crate version:** `binloc` had a hard-coded 2.2.0 and now uses `version.workspace = true`.
- **Tests:** `autotests = false` hid `formats.rs`, so I removed it along with the one `[[test]]` entry. `make test` now runs `cli`, `formats` and the `binloc-core` tests.
- **Core on its own:** `binloc-core` relied on `binloc` to switch on checkchar's `iso7064` feature. Each crate now names its own features: core asks for `iso7064`, the program for `luhn`.
- **No-`json` build:** `emit_json` called the `json` module even when that module wasn't compiled. I added a stub for builds without the feature. That build now prints "json output is not available in this build" and exits 2.
- **Site table:** `build.rs` only watched itself. It now also watches `data/sites.csv`, so an edit reaches the binary through a plain `make build`.
- **Reproducible binary:** the Makefile now sets `RUSTFLAGS=--remap-path-prefix=$(CURDIR)=/build`.
- **Dependencies:** I refreshed `Cargo.lock` through the mirror and re-vendored with `cargo vendor`.
  - checkchar is now 1.3.0. It changed `mod37_2` to return `#` instead of `*`, so core calls `mod37_2_iso` and the check character stays `*` as the docs say.
  - fieldsplit is held at 0.4.1. The newest release, 0.4.3, needs Rust 1.70, which conflicts with the "no crate may need a newer compiler" rule.

**What I ran**
- `make test` passed.
- `cargo test --frozen -p binloc-core` passed.
- `cargo build --frozen --release -p binloc --no-default-features` built, and `--format json` gave the expected error and exit status 2.
- `make build COMMIT=abc123` in two different directories gave the same SHA-256, and the binary contains no build path.
- After editing a row in `sites.csv`, an incremental `make build` showed the change in `binloc sites`.
- With `COMMIT` omitted, `--version` prints `(commit unknown)`.
- With a different `[workspace.package]` version, `--version` reports it. `Cargo.lock` has to be regenerated first (`cargo update --offline -w`), because `make build` runs with `--frozen` and the lock records the workspace version.
- I found no compiler warnings in the default or no-default-features builds.

I left the usage text unchanged. It lacks the `binloc --help` line that the docs synopsis shows, and I wasn't sure which one is authoritative.

I ran `make clean` afterwards to remove `target/` and `bin/`.

command_result.command: cd /app && git status 2>&1 | head -3; find . -path ./vendor -prune -o -path ./target -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/BUILDING.md docs/binloc.md

cd /app && cat Makefile Cargo.toml .cargo/config.toml .gitignore crates/*/Cargo.toml Cargo.lock CHANGELOG.md; ls vendor /srv/cargo-mirror; head -20 crates/binloc-core/data/sites.csv; cat crates/binloc-core/build.rs
cd /app && cat crates/binloc/src/main.rs crates/binloc/src/json.rs; rustc --version; cargo --version

cd /app && cat crates/binloc/tests/*.rs | head -150; cat crates/binloc-core/tests/locations.rs | head -60; ls vendor/*; for d in vendor/*; do cat $d/Cargo.toml | head -30; done; ls /srv/cargo-mirror/index -R; cat /srv/cargo-mirror/index/*/*/* 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp && for c in checkchar-1.2.0 checkchar-1.3.0 fieldsplit-0.4.1 fieldsplit-0.4.3; do mkdir -p x/$c && tar xzf /srv/cargo-mirror/$c.crate -C x/$c; done; cd x; find . -type f | sort; cat */*/Cargo.toml; cat */*/CHANGELOG.md; diff -r checkchar-1.2.0/checkchar-1.2.0 /app/vendor/checkchar; diff -r fieldsplit-0.4.3/fieldsplit-0.4.3 /app/vendor/fieldsplit

cd /tmp/x && for d in */*; do echo "=== $d"; cat $d/Cargo.toml $d/CHANGELOG.md; done; diff -r checkchar-1.2.0/checkchar-1.2.0 /app/vendor/checkchar; diff -r fieldsplit-0.4.3/fieldsplit-0.4.3 /app/vendor/fieldsplit
cd /tmp/x && cat checkchar-1.3.0/*/src/lib.rs; diff checkchar-1.2.0/*/src/lib.rs checkchar-1.3.0/*/src/lib.rs | head -50; diff fieldsplit-0.4.1/*/src/lib.rs fieldsplit-0.4.3/*/src/lib.rs

cd /app && sed -i 's|^checkchar = .*|checkchar = { version = "1.3", default-features = false, features = ["luhn"] }|' crates/binloc/Cargo.toml && sed -i 's|^checkchar = .*|checkchar = { version = "1.3", default-features = false, features = ["iso7064"] }|' crates/binloc-core/Cargo.toml && grep -n checkchar crates/*/Cargo.toml

cd /app && C='source.crates-io.replace-with="mirror"' && cargo update --offline --config "$C" 2>&1 | tail; cargo update --offline --config "$C" -p fieldsplit --precise 0.4.1 2>&1 | tail; rm -rf vendor && cargo vendor --offline --respect-source-config --config "$C" vendor 2>&1 | tail -20; cat Cargo.lock; ls -a vendor/*; cat .cargo/config.toml

cd /app && make test 2>&1 | tail -50; cargo test --frozen -p binloc-core 2>&1 | tail -8; cargo build --frozen --release -p binloc --no-default-features 2>&1 | tail -5; target/release/binloc check --format json </dev/null; echo $?

rm -rf /tmp/a /tmp/b && mkdir /tmp/a /tmp/b && cd /app && tar cf - --exclude=./target --exclude=./bin . | tee >(tar xf - -C /tmp/a) | tar xf - -C /tmp/b; for d in a b; do (cd /tmp/$d && make build COMMIT=abc123 >/dev/null 2>&1; sha256sum bin/binloc; bin/binloc --version; grep -c /tmp/$d bin/binloc); done; cd /tmp/a && make build 2>&1 | tail -2; bin/binloc --version; sed -i 's/^WL5,6,200/WL5,7,200/' crates/binloc-core/data/sites.csv && make build COMMIT=abc123 2>&1 | tail -3; bin/binloc sites | grep WL5; sed -i 's/^version = "2.3.0"/version = "9.9.9"/' Cargo.toml; cp /app/Cargo.lock /tmp/lk; make build 2>&1 | tail -2; bin/binloc --version
